title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-a4n2.3: missing newline before tx_queue_destroy declaration
description: In tx_queue.c:447, the tx_queue_destroy function has no blank line separating it from tx_queue_clear (which ends at line 445). While functionally harmless, this is a minor style violation — every other function in the file has a blank-line separator. Readability issue only, no runtime impact.
